sources.title: French Interior Ministry: visas for overseas France
sources.officialityEvidence: The French Interior Ministry explains that overseas entry conditions are governed by territory-specific orders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: des arrêtés spécifiques à chaque collectivité ou territoire d'outre-mer

sources.title: Current Annex II: French Guiana and Réunion entry visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Légifrance publishes the consolidated DROM Annex II in force since 19 June 2025, including passport-qualified entries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Version en vigueur depuis le 19 juin 2025

sources.title: Current Annex II: Mayotte entry visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Légifrance publishes the current Mayotte Annex II; its Montenegro waiver is passport-document qualified.
sources.supportingExcerpt: dispensés de visa pour entrer sur le territoire de Mayotte

sources.title: Current French Polynesia and New Caledonia entry orders
sources.officialityEvidence: The French Polynesia order is a current consolidated legal source; the territory-specific New Caledonia order is separately published by Légifrance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sont dispensés du visa prévu à l'article 1er les étrangers mentionnés à l'annexe II.

sources.title: Dominican Republic DGII: Tourist Card entry list
sources.officialityEvidence: The official DGII page publishes its Tourist Card and consular-visa country list, including an express residual formulation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los nacionales de los países que no aparecen en el listado anterior deben ingresar con la Tarjeta de Turista.

sources.title: Dominican Republic MIREX ordinary tourist selector: Montenegro
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MIREX service returns a Montenegro, ordinary-passport, tourist-visa result, which conflicts with the DGII list.

sources.title: Mauritius Passport and Immigration Office: Visa Requirement Country-wise (2025)
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Passport and Immigration Office embeds this country-wise table; it uses a legacy Serbia-and-Montenegro label rather than a current Montenegro ordinary-passport row.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Afghanistan Visa required prior to travel.

sources.title: Grenada visa requirements schedule
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the People's Republic of China, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry mission page links this schedule, which identifies itself as updated February 2021 without a current-force statement.

sources.title: North Macedonia MFA: Do you need a visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The official selector does not provide a reproducible current Montenegro result; direct and rendered retrieval previously timed out.

sources.title: South Sudan eVisa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live portal identifies the South Sudan Ministry of Interior and shows electronic PDF delivery, but asks applicants to establish eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process.
